scope: architecture reconstruction, two reused adapters, development only
conclusion: SVD500 reconstructs the normalized fitting gradients more closely, but the locked SVD components produce weaker all-family signed steering than dictionary atoms and fail the combined description, selectivity and quality requirements.
findings: Across all five families and all five strengths, SVD signed response is 6.32/9.98 percentage points in seeds42/43, versus dictionary 20.82/18.46. Paired SVD-minus-dictionary intervals are -15.46 to -13.54 and -9.74 to -7.32 percentage points. Both frozen primary requirements fail.

SVD missing-input clarification passes the narrow target-versus-control gradient descriptor checks in both seeds. It fails controlled specificity and quality in both; this is a limited descriptive result, not validated selective control.

SVD numbered passes descriptor and selectivity checks only in seed42. Its signed response is 23.6/12.1 points, with serious quality and length costs and seed43 descriptor failure. It cannot rescue the failed aggregate.

Every family of both methods fails the joint controlled quality requirement across the full fixed strength grid. Stronger dictionary steering alone is therefore not a demonstration of clean or robust interpretable control.

Normalized fitting-row reconstruction relative error is 0.519/0.516 for SVD versus 0.766/0.760 for dictionary. SVD uses about 500 active coefficients per row versus dictionary 7.79/7.51. This is fitting reconstruction at matched candidate count, not matched sparsity, held-out forecasts, or an efficiency result.
The code direction has negative all-strength signed response for dictionary in both seeds and SVD in seed42. No orientations or strengths were changed after seeing this result.
limits: Original paper rank8 checkpoint was unavailable; this is an architecture reconstruction, not exact checkpoint replication.
Training selection/coherence does not validate all 500 components. Narrow held-out descriptor pairs use controlled content but are not exactly matched in token length.
Public prompts and two reused adapters make this development evidence. Family comparisons use 99% marginal Bonferroni intervals; aggregate intervals are pointwise95%.

Under the frozen execution amendment, seed42 baseline was on A100 while bullets/numbered conditions were on H100. Matched method pairs within each family share hardware, but baseline-relative quality can include device differences.

Physical descriptor cosines passed hash, shape, finiteness and range audit; descriptor coefficients and saved response metrics were recomputed. The original full descriptor gradients were not saved for independent cosine recomputation.
No post-hoc low-strength winner, direction sign flip, or family-only primary claim.
